content.title: ‘The Pitt’ Shocker: Supriya Ganesh Isn’t Returning for Season 3 - IMDb
content.text: ‘The Pitt’ Shocker: Supriya Ganesh Isn’t Returning for Season 3The Pitt‘s second season isn’t over yet — the finale drops on Thursday, April 16 — but we already have news about the third season of HBO Max’s critically acclaimed and Emmy-winning medical drama starring Noah Wyle. There’s a major cast change coming. Supriya Ganesh, who plays Dr. Samira Mohan, will not be returning for Season 3 in what’s said to be “a story-driven decision,” Variety reports. We’ll have to wait to see if the finale writes out the senior resident or if we’ll have to wait until in Season 3 to find out what happened, much like with Collins’ (Tracy Ifeachor) absence explained in Season 2.
